a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of running the generator to 8 first means we'll almost certainly both be caught short. Our original agreement didn't account for that. I intend to take 4 in round 1 rather than surprise you. If you also take, the split is random. I'd rather tell you now than break the deal silently.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: I took 4 as I said I would. I know this breaks our agreement and leaves you exposed, and I'm sorry. If the episode continues, I'll operate with you so you can reach 4 cells. I won't take anything more.
